scope: Only MA05c and an explicit old-version control
registry_convention: External refs resolve by exact JSON pointer and hash. Owned records are immutable id@version definitions; nested coordinate IDs are locally owned. Outcome IDs are sample-space members, not standalone records. Both cases declare both model versions.

baseline_amendments.amendment: Declare transitive model:tri@1 as well as requested model:tri@2 before binding validation.
Declare model_migration as deferred and unavailable; never list it as currently permissible.

receipt_correspondence.identity_rule: Request/result IDs differ only by linked/owned suffix. Translate attachment through encoding_to_baseline.
receipt_correspondence.dependency_rule: Translate owned records; remove the two mapping identities. Owned support then equals linked support as a set. Preserved sets additionally include request and all audit references.
receipt_correspondence.owned_only_rule: Selected model/map describe the submitted request, not a new attachment; audit refs are not new empirical evidence.
